command:
set -eu
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "a4b1f629c1286d631ac208515b71aeeaa7c44b23" ]
[ -z "$(git status --short)" ]
export IDF_PYTHON_ENV_PATH=/Users/michal/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.13_env
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null
rm -rf /tmp/c6-smoke-build /tmp/c6-smoke-sdkconfig /tmp/c6-smoke.defaults /tmp/c6-port /tmp/c6-smoke.log
cat > /tmp/c6-smoke.defaults <<'EOF'
CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_BACKEND_UART=y
CONFIG_GATEWAY_LINK_BACKEND_I2C=n
EOF
idf.py -B /tmp/c6-smoke-build -D SDKCONFIG=/tmp/c6-smoke-sdkconfig -D "SDKCONFIG_DEFAULTS=$PWD/sdkconfig.defaults;/tmp/c6-smoke.defaults" build
/Users/michal/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.13_env/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from serial.tools import list_ports
ports = list(list_ports.comports())
matches = [p.device for p in ports if p.vid == 0x303A and p.pid == 0x1001]
if len(matches) != 1:
    print('serial ports:')
    for p in ports:
        print(p.device, hex(p.vid or 0), hex(p.pid or 0), p.description)
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one ESP32-C6 USB Serial/JTAG port, found {matches}')
Path('/tmp/c6-port').write_text(matches[0])
print('C6_PORT=' + matches[0])
PY
PORT=$(cat /tmp/c6-port)
idf.py -B /tmp/c6-smoke-build -D SDKCONFIG=/tmp/c6-smoke-sdkconfig -p "$PORT" app-flash
